gloss: day after day; every day; for days on end

definitions.gloss: day after day; every day; for days on end
definitions.explanation: Multiple consecutive days. Emphasizes that something continues happening without interruption over a series of days.

examples.japanese: {連日|れんじつ}⟦{猛暑|もうしょ}→猛暑：08311_mousho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The extreme heat has been continuing day after day.

examples.japanese: {連日|れんじつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧たまって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm exhausted from working overtime day after day.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{連日|れんじつ}⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧おり、⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関心|かんしん}→関心：00182_kanshin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まっている→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧。
examples.english: This news has been reported on day after day, and public interest is growing.

notes:
A compound of {連|れん} (continuous) + {日|じつ} (day). Used as both a noun and an adverb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連日|れんじつ}⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (to continue day after day)
- {連日|れんじつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{猛暑|もうしょ}→猛暑：08311_mousho⟧ (consecutive days of extreme heat)
- {連日|れんじつ}⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be reported on daily)
- {連日|れんじつ}⟦{満員|まんいん}→満員：07584_manin⟧ (full house every day)
- {連日|れんじつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧ (exhaustion from consecutive days)

Common in weather reports and news. Similar to ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧ (every day) but emphasizes that something has been continuous and ongoing, often with a nuance of persistence or endurance.
